name: Sumo Stance

card.plain: Hold the button to brace, then let go to dash into the move, faster the longer you held.
card.frames: Hold up to 30 ticks; dash during startup at 14 / 18 / 22 / 26 units per tick (0-9 / 10-19 / 20-29 / 30 ticks held), capped at 26. No damage change.

notes: DESIGNER DECISION 2026-10-20: 'holding charge' = holding longer gives a faster dash, up to a maximum speed; replaces the GDD table's '+20% damage' (needs an amendment in docs/design/gdd-amendments.md, producer). All numbers are PROPOSED. Reference speeds: walk 12.8 u/tick (C2), forward dash 300 u / 18 frames = 16.7 u/tick (E10), so uncharged 14 is a little under a dash and the cap 26 is about 1.5x a dash. The dash covers the special's own startup frames only (startup 10 = 140-260 units; startup 16 = 224-416), so hitboxes, active and recovery stay the clip's truth (F2) and only position changes. No new animation (A10): the dash plays the special's own matched clip unretimed (root travel stripped, the dash is data, as for Oni's rush and E15); during the hold Ryo plays the existing ryo-crouch clip (Kappa uses Ryo's clips). Retiming is not used, so F2's 0.5x-2x and 4-frame hold limits are not touched. Trade-off: the special starts up to 30 ticks late, so the player buys reach and surprise with time; it is not a damage buff (P1). Kihon parity (K3): the held input is 'special_trigger', whichever button fires the special: Kihon holds Special, Kata (no Special button, K1) holds the button that completes the slot's motion. Same window and steps in both; no Kata bonus beyond K1's +10% precision. Only Ryo and the test bots use the hold; the Tanuki copy never includes modifiers (T4) and yokai AI reads only on-screen state (P6). Any non-projectile special can take it (a dash with a cast makes no sense); frame-data 'requires' cannot express exclusion. ENGINE/SCHEMA NEEDS (gameplay-programmer; schema NOT edited here): (1) common.schema.json modifierCondition: new 'charge_released', read on the release tick with the held tick count; (2) effectTarget: allow 'properties.forward_travel' (the field exists in frame-data.schema.json but nothing in game/scripts reads it yet, and it is a total distance, not a per-tick speed); (3) modifier.schema.json: a 'charge' object as above (button, window_ticks, step_ticks, units_per_tick_by_step as integers, cap) and 'applies_to.excludes'; (4) engine: a holding state after the special's command in which the move has not started (E7's 40-tick charge is a motion charge, a different mechanism; the 30-tick window here is separate and proposed), held ticks read on release, an integer per-tick position step during startup, hold ticks in the state hash (deterministic); (5) a harness hook so test bots can choose a hold length (bots only). OPEN QUESTIONS, not decided: (a) step 0 (a tap) still dashes at 14: confirm a tap is not 'no charge'; (b) at 30 ticks, auto-release or keep holding; (c) EX (E16) interaction; (d) whether Ryo can be hit or thrown while bracing; (e) 'op: set' replaces any existing forward_travel on Iron-Club Charge and Torrent Spin; (f) the dash overlaps Rising Talisman's frames 1-5 of air invulnerability. Until then this file does not validate against modifier.schema.json (unknown 'charge', 'excludes' and 'when' value).
